podcast.body: A song released in 1954 featuring a guitar solo by Scotty Moore, which is considered a potential candidate for the first rock solo on record. "Elvis Presley's Good Rockets tonight in 1954."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: Elvis Presley recorded a cover of "Good Rockin' Tonight" that significantly restructured Roy Brown's original. His version added a repeat of the first line and a chord change, establishing a more conventional 16-bar blues form which subsequently influenced many other cover versions. "It might also sound odd to anyone who's familiar with later cover versions, by Elvis Presley or by Paul McCartney and others who followed the pattern of Elvis's version."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 7: "Good Rockin' Tonight" by Wynonie Harris
